[[File:Ancient relic detail.png|150px|left]]
The '''ancient relic''' is a drop obtained from [[revenants]] found in the [[Revenant Caves]].

It can be given to the [[Emblem Trader]] wandering around in the Revenant Caves in exchange for 16,000,000 [[coins]]. This '''must''' be done while on the official [[Bounty Hunter]] world. The statuette '''cannot''' be given to him in [[Edgeville]]. A [[chisel]] can be used on the ancient relic to break it into 32,000 [[revenant ether]].

Much like the [[bracelet of ethereum]], the relic is '''always lost''' on death, even if it is the only item in the player's inventory.

==Item sources==
{{Drop sources|Ancient relic}}
The drop rate from Revenants is increased when [[Skull (status)|skulled]]. This does not apply to the skull given by a [[PvP world#High-risk%20worlds|high-risk PvP world]].
